# InsideHook

> > InsideHook is a men's lifestyle and culture publication covering everything from sports and technology to entertainment, travel, and modern living.

Founded as a digital magazine for curious, engaged readers, InsideHook features in-depth articles, cultural commentary, and expert advice across sports, science, entertainment, and lifestyle topics. The site also operates InsideHook Shop, offering exclusive branded merchandise.

## Key Topics

- Lifestyle and culture journalism
- Fantasy football and sports analysis
- Extreme sports and parkour
- Digital communication and texting etiquette
- Technology and innovation (Tesla, CRISPR)
- Entertainment and pop culture
- Travel and adventure
- Whiskey and spirits
- UFC and combat sports
- Modern masculinity and advice
- InsideHook Shop merchandise
- 1980s nostalgia and history
- Science and research
- Photography and visual storytelling

## Sports and Competition

- [How the Experts Win at Fantasy Football](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/08/26/how-the-experts-win-at-fantasy-football): Expert fantasy football draft strategy featuring Antonio Brown analysis
- [Does Fantasy Football Success Require More Skill than the NFL?](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/09/17/does-fantasy-football-success-require-more-skill-than-the-nfl): DFS skill vs gambling debate analyzing FanDuel and DraftKings legality
- [The Five Fights That Made the UFC Worth $4.2 Billion](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/07/09/the-five-fights-that-made-the-ufc-worth-4-2-billion): Historic UFC fights that built the $4.2B MMA franchise valuation
- [The Competitive Sport of Indoor Skydiving](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/09/19/did-you-know-indoor-skydiving-is-a-competitive-sport): FAI World Cup indoor skydiving competition at Warsaw's Flyspot

## Extreme Sports and Adventure

- [Free Runners Perform Acrobatic Moves Through a Port in Turkey](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/08/01/jason-paul-dimitris-kyrsanidis-parkour-dreamland): Jason Paul and Dimitris Kyrsanidis parkour at Port of Haydarpasa
- [Watch Death-Defying Skyscraper Parkour](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/08/19/watch-death-defying-skyscraper-parkour): Serbian Oleg Cricket's extreme skyscraper parkour stunts video
- [See the World From a Pilot's Perspective](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/09/27/what-a-thunderstorm-looks-like-from-a-pilots-perspective): Christiaan van Heijst's cockpit photography of Northern Lights storms

## Technology and Innovation

- [Could Genetically Modified Mosquitos Help Cure Malaria?](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/07/19/could-genetically-modified-mosquitos-help-cure-malaria): CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing for malaria eradication via Harvard research
- [The Edorado 7S is The Tesla of Speedboats](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/08/06/the-edorado-7s-is-the-tesla-of-speedboats): Edorado Marine's electric hydrofoil speedboat innovation review
- [The Reasons New York City Streets Are Constantly Under Construction](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/08/29/the-reasons-new-york-city-streets-are-constantly-under-construction): NYC infrastructure and underground utilities construction explained

## Culture and Entertainment

- [Kendrick Lamar Creates Novels as Albums](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/07/07/kendrick-lamar-creates-novels-as-albums): Analysis of Kendrick Lamar's narrative album approach by Matthew Reitman
- [FBI Couldn't Decipher Lyrics to 'Louie, Louie'](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/04/25/fbi-couldnt-decipher-lyrics-to-louie-louie): FBI investigation of The Kingsmen's obscenity controversy in 1960s
- [1980's Archive](https://www.insidehook.com/1980s): Archive of 1980s culture and lifestyle articles featuring Sam Fragoso
- [Donald Trump Lets Jimmy Fallon Mess Up His Hair](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/09/16/donald-trump-lets-jimmy-fallon-mess-up-his-hair): Trump's Tonight Show appearance with Jimmy Fallon during 2016 election

## Advice and Modern Living

- [The Difference Between Texting kk, ok, okay, and k](https://www.insidehook.com/advice/the-difference-between-texting-k-ok-kk-explained): Texting etiquette guide explaining k, ok, kk differences by Logan Mahan
- [Single Malts Be Damned: This Distillery Blends Its Whiskey (and Is Proud of It)](https://www.insidehook.com/2016/07/20/single-malts-be-damned-this-distillery-blends-its-whiskey-and-is-proud-of-it): High West Distillery's Park City blended whiskey philosophy by Coyle
